addition.item: First public Joomla 6 suite release since the plugin-only line at 1.0.3 (intermediate 1.0.4–1.0.6 and 2.0.x builds were not published)
Suite shell com_devartarticletools with dashboard hub, Settings, Schema and Legacy Migration
Child components with own config.xml, access.xml and ACL: Article Photo, Social Cards, Recent Articles, Social Share and Authors
Content plugin plg_content_devartarticletools for inside1/inside2 module positions and intro styling (SubscriberInterface)
Social Share content plugin and Open Graph system plugin (SubscriberInterface)
Schema system plugin plg_system_devartarticletools for Article JSON-LD (disabled by default)
Administrator module mod_devartarticletools_recent with Control Panel (cpanel) placement on install/update; publish is opt-in via Recent Articles → Options → Installer
Authors: groups, profiles, virtual authors, SEF pages, list/card layouts and performance-oriented article queries
15 packaged locales: en-GB, el-GR, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, pt-PT, cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR, zh-CN
Hub summaries and product intros across dashboard child apps

change.item: Product identity moves from standalone content plugin ZIP to package-only updates (pkg_devartarticletools)
Joomla native updates target the package; content plugin element devartarticletools is unchanged for Positions/Intro runtime
Positions and Intro settings migrate from legacy plugin params to the suite component on first package install
Photo, Social Cards, Recent Articles and Social Share settings migrate from the shell component to their child components
PHP minimum raised to 8.3.0; Joomla 6+ only
Package update server and changelog use repository root update.xml and changelog.xml (Slider/Widgets/Exts pattern)

security.item: Schema and Open Graph article loaders enforce published state, visitor access levels and publish_up/publish_down windows
Open Graph queries use DatabaseInterface with whereIn and bound parameters
Shell administrator href attributes are HTML-escaped
Social Share copy uses Clipboard API only (no document.execCommand fallback)
defined(_JEXEC) on package and component installer scripts; GPL headers on Authors templates

fix.item: ReturnUrlHelper uses plain base64_encode (no string obfuscation)
Removed stale feature_socialmeta language strings and dead Socialmeta administrator views
Brand footers use language keys across suite child apps
Documented intentional admin-only filter=raw for Social Share og_custom_rules

note.item: Public release replacing the previous GitHub line at content plugin 1.0.3
Sites on plugin 1.0.3: install pkg_devartarticletools_v2.1.0.zip once; Positions/Intro params migrate automatically; later updates use Joomla native package updates
Legacy DevArt Article Photo, Social Cards and Backend Tools are detected but never silent-uninstalled
Disable legacy standalone injectors manually if they duplicate Open Graph or share output
Recommended update for all DevArt Article Tools installations on 1.0.3 or earlier

change.item: Legacy content-plugin update channel now offers the suite package pkg_devartarticletools_v2.1.0.zip for sites still on plugin-only 1.0.3 installs
After installing the package once, use Joomla Updates on pkg_devartarticletools for future releases

note.item: Plugin element and folder are unchanged (content / devartarticletools)
Install the package ZIP; do not use the old plg_content_devartarticletools standalone ZIP on new sites

fix.item: Social Share HtmlView uses DatabaseInterface instead of DatabaseDriver string lookup
Remove stale feature_socialmeta language strings and dead Socialmeta view/tmpl
ReturnUrlHelper uses plain base64_encode; Social Share copy uses Clipboard API only
Brand footers use language keys; smoke-herd accepts DEVART_JOOMLA_CLI env overrides
Document intentional filter=raw for og_custom_rules (admin-only) in Options description and API policy
Add defined(_JEXEC) guards to package, Authors and Recent Articles installer scripts
Add GPL license headers to all Authors admin and site template files (JED hygiene)
Open Graph article loader uses DatabaseInterface with whereIn and bound publish parameters
Social Share content plugin listens via SubscriberInterface (AfterTitle/AfterDisplay events)
Shell dashboard and settings hub href attributes are HTML-escaped
Remove unused settings/default_socialmeta.php leftover template
Schema system plugin loads articles only when published, within publish window, and visible to the visitor access levels
Package update server and changelog URLs point to source/package/ metadata; root update.xml and changelog.xml synced for existing installs

change.item: Phase 3 i18n: add cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR and zh-CN across all 25 reference language files
Hub summaries for Authors, Social Cards, Article Photo and Recent Articles across all 15 packaged locales
Roboto Condensed Apache License notice added beside DejaVu license in Social Cards

addition.item: Suite release: com_devartarticletools control centre with modular Feature layout
Recent Articles feature and administrator module mod_devartarticletools_recent
System plugin plg_system_devartarticletools (disabled by default) for feature-flagged schema
Legacy Migration detection for Photo, Social Cards, and Backend Tools (never silent uninstall)

change.item: Major internal version jump from plugin-only 1.0.x to suite 2.0.x (unpublished development line)

fix.item: Removed external CSS asset dependency
Fixed potential stylesheet loading issues on some Joomla installations
Fixed frontend rendering dependency on external plugin CSS file

change.item: Replaced external CSS loading with lightweight inline CSS rendering
Improved compatibility across Joomla 6 hosting environments

note.item: Last public plugin-only release before the 2.1.0 suite package

addition.item: inside1 and inside2 article module positions without template overrides

note.item: Initial public release for Joomla 6 websites
